headline: Mexico's labor market moderates job creation in the third quarter, adds 122,000 employed
summary: Mexico's labor market added 122,348 employed people in the third quarter, below the previous period. Unemployment rose to 2.9%, while informal employment reached record highs.
why: Employment and unemployment data are key gauges of economic momentum, consumer spending capacity and the likely path of Mexican interest rates.
original_headline: Mercado laboral en México modera creación de empleo en el tercer trimestre, suma 122,000 ocupados
